Evidence: At least two submitters agree, with no conflicting interpretations
Findings: HPS3 gene has one heterozygous pathogenic variant detected that is associated with Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome 3.
Interpretation: Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome 3 follows an autosomal recessive inheritance pattern. Detection of a single pathogenic variant suggests carrier status. Two pathogenic variants, typically one inherited from each parent and confirmed to be in trans, are generally required for disease manifestation.
